headline: 0 on-chain addresses catalogued; protocol confirmed as Sanctum-based LST on Solana but mint/pool addresses only appeared as truncated snippets and could not be verified

findings.text: D1: No Solana block explorer (Solscan, SolanaFM) fetch succeeded — all attempted URLs were blocked by the allowlist (addresses not yet pinned). Sanctum explore-page search snippet showed truncated token address 'sctm...rQpx' and stake pool 'pyZM...SnbP' but full 44-char base58 addresses cannot be reconstructed from these fragments without fabrication.

D2: Protocol website https://defidevcorp.com/?tab=dfdvSOLcom is fully JavaScript-rendered; both fetch attempts returned only the page title with no body content. No deployed-contracts doc or address list was surfaced. deployed_contracts_doc set to null.

D3: No audit links were provided in the per-protocol context and no audit reports were discovered via search. The Nasdaq press release contains a disclaimer stating DFDV 'is not responsible for the development, security, or operation of Sanctum's technology or infrastructure,' implying reliance on Sanctum's audit posture. No DFDV-specific audit PDF found.

D4: No GitHub repository was provided in the per-protocol context. Search did not surface a DFDV-owned GitHub repo containing deployment artifacts. The LST infrastructure is developed by Sanctum (https://sanctum.so); no DFDV-specific source repo found.
D5: Single chain — Solana only. Same blocking issues apply; zero addresses surfaced from attempted fetches of Solscan/SolanaFM for this chain.
D6: No factory addresses could be verified. The Sanctum stake-pool program is the factory analog for LSTs; its address appeared only in truncated form in search snippets.
D7: No complete addresses obtained; role taxonomy cannot be populated.

D8: Two address fragments surfaced from Sanctum explore search snippet (token address 'sctm...rQpx', stake pool 'pyZM...SnbP') are snippet-only sightings — full addresses not confirmed by a fetched URL. Recorded in unknowns[] per D8 rules.

rationale.verdict: Corpora walked: protocol website (JS-rendered, no content), Nasdaq press release, multiple news/PR sources via search. Established that dfdvSOL is a Sanctum-powered LST on Solana launched ~Feb 2025, but zero on-chain addresses could be pinned from fetched sources. Two truncated address fragments from a search snippet are insufficient for admin_addresses[]. Full discovery blocked by JS-only website, absent GitHub, absent audit links, and allowlist rejection of Solscan/SolanaFM URLs not yet seen in prior fetched content.

protocol_metadata.about: DFDV Staked SOL (dfdvSOL) is a liquid staking token on Solana issued by DeFi Development Corp. (Nasdaq: DFDV), a publicly traded company. Users stake SOL to DFDV-operated validators and receive dfdvSOL in return, maintaining liquidity while earning staking rewards automatically reflected in the token's redemption value. The protocol is built on infrastructure provided by Sanctum, a Solana liquid staking platform, and dfdvSOL is accepted as collateral on Jupiter Lend with up to 92% LTV. DFDV describes itself as the first US public company to hold Solana-based LSTs on its balance sheet.
